kddcup99_sa.slice: 10,000 random rows (rows 10,001-20,000 of a seed-2026 permutation)

preregistration.expected_outcome:
Outperforms. On the development slices flag F1 improved on all three datasets -- KDD
+0.14 (95% CI +0.12 to +0.16), Covertype +0.13 (+0.12 to +0.15), card fraud +0.18 (+0.08
to +0.29) -- each at Holm p 0.0006, with no false-positive-budget or stability
regression. The card-fraud interval is the widest (few frauds per hour), so it is the
dataset most likely to change the verdict.
preregistration.hypothesis:
The round-2 synthetic result carries over to real labelled data: at each dataset's
review budget, composite-agreement@1 flags anomalies with higher flag F1 than the
unanimous default, on network-intrusion traffic (KDD Cup 1999 SA), forest cover types
(Covertype 2 vs 4) and card fraud scored out of time (each hour fitted, the next scored),
without spending more than the review budget on wrong rows where the default does not and
without less stable flags.
